<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Staff at Keelwater accounts experience confusion and processing errors when the platform's interface changes without prior notice, forcing disruptive mid-week retraining and reducing accuracy in claims processing. Customers describe controls moving without warning and having to relearn where things are [i:1510a29a4fb29690]. At Linnet House Insurance, the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning and the team had to retrain mid-week [i:1413d66ef39a615c]. Stannary Commercial reported that unexpected interface changes forced mid-cycle retraining, causing errors in claims and payments processing [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].

## Who is affected

- 8 accounts are affected, across 22 mentions and 4 routes [i:1413d66ef39a615c].
- Linnet House Insurance (ARR £360000.0, renewal 2027-03-14) raised 5 mentions, including having to retrain three people just to find a new location, with someone submitting a payment in error because a button moved [i:47b4aa196c53aee4].
- Stannary Commercial (ARR £540000.0, renewal 2026-12-05) raised 4 mentions, reporting delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613].
- Brindlecombe Home raised 3 mentions, noting that interface tweaks are throwing off the team's rhythm [i:3d342905b300858e].
- Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860000.0, renewal 2027-01-20) raised 3 mentions, having retrained its claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes [i:a836bad7459a12dc].
- Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1250000.0, renewal 2027-03-31) raised 2 mentions, saying controls moving without warning is forcing constant retraining [i:61b29d8e38a6e617].
- Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1950000.0, renewal 2027-06-30) raised 2 mentions, having to retrain half the team after the last update moved the reserves button [i:7888b62932d7f8cb].
- Penhallow Specialty Risks (ARR £230000.0, renewal 2027-06-18) raised 1 mention, reporting trouble accessing its reserves dashboard after an update [i:830db45f56629e54].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2400000.0, renewal 2027-01-15) raised 1 mention, still seeing errors after controls moved without warning [i:a590adfec9690173].
- 1 renewal falls within 90 days [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].

## Evidence

- Support route (9 mentions): Linnet House Insurance said the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning and the team had to retrain mid-week [i:1413d66ef39a615c]; Stannary Commercial said the changes caused delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613]; Wexmoor Motor said the last update moved the reserves button and half the team had to be retrained [i:7888b62932d7f8cb]; Penhallow Specialty Risks reported trouble accessing its reserves dashboard after the update last week [i:830db45f56629e54].
- Onboarding route (1 mention): an account reported unannounced screen changes that caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was, and asked for advance notice and previews [i:1510a29a4fb29690].
- Sales route (6 mentions): Linnet House Insurance said it had to retrain three people just to find the new location, and someone submitted a payment in error because the button moved [i:47b4aa196c53aee4]; Brindlecombe Home said the unexpected interface changes mean staff keep having to retrain because buttons and menus shift without warning, costing time and accuracy [i:211006eeabec013f].
- Account management route (6 mentions): Callowfield Auto Assurance said controls moving without warning is forcing constant retraining [i:f2f56b8b1308d082]; Quillon Business Insurance said staff are making errors because controls are not where they were last week [i:944e38886aa3e0f9]; Hollinbrook Home Insurance said teams had to retrain and errors are still being seen [i:a590adfec9690173].
- Customers are asking for advance notice and previews before changes go live so they do not waste time retraining [i:1b3b992fef61581a], and for predictability so staff do not have to keep relearning where things are [i:7dccff3918b6f081].
- Brindlecombe Home asked for fewer surprises and more notice before major shifts in how claims or documents are accessed [i:ad38c9f354762a62].

## Why now

- 1 renewal falls within 90 days, at Stannary Commercial on 2026-12-05, and that account has reported mid-cycle retraining causing errors in claims and payments processing [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].
- Quillon Business Insurance renews on 2027-01-20 and has retrained its claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes [i:a836bad7459a12dc].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance renews on 2027-01-15 and is still seeing errors after controls moved without warning [i:a590adfec9690173].
- The affected accounts represent £7590000.0 in ARR as of 2026-10-01 [i:1413d66ef39a615c].
", "citations": ["1413d66ef39a615c", "1510a29a4fb29690", "1b3b992fef61581a", "211006eeabec013f", "3a4ae29f32b5253f", "3d342905b300858e", "47b4aa196c53aee4", "573ca417ce82f613", "61b29d8e38a6e617", "7888b62932d7f8cb", "7dccff3918b6f081", "830db45f56629e54", "944e38886aa3e0f9", "a590adfec9690173", "a836bad7459a12dc", "ad38c9f354762a62", "f2f56b8b1308d082"]}
